ad_info.reference_style: Bold editorial two-tone Q&A ad: a dark plum question zone with an oversized left-aligned question and a giant tone-on-tone question mark, a pale blush answer zone with a short direct answer, and the real bottle straddling the color split
ad_info.angle_used: Objeción de confianza: ¿tiene registro INVIMA y pago al recibir?

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. Secondary colors for this variation: plum (top zone #2B1226, question mark #3A1A33) and pale blush pink (bottom zone #FBE3EE).
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, clean editorial design with the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.graphic_language: Two flat solid color zones split by one straight line, one outlined pill, one giant tone-on-tone question mark, clean high-contrast typography. No glow, no particles.
global_identity.text_typography: Question in Montserrat ExtraBold; kicker and answer in Inter (SemiBold / Regular, verdict in Bold). Maximum three text levels.

creative_objective: Answer head-on the doubt that most stops the purchase for the woman who already lost money on pills online: yes, it has the sanitary registration, and she pays when she receives it.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The oversized question in the dark plum top zone. 2) The real bottle straddling the split on the right. 3) The answer in the pale blush zone, its verdict 'Sí:' in bold fuchsia. 4) The small kicker pill.
art_direction.composition_style: Two-tone horizontal split with a strong left text edge at 6% of the width in both zones. The bottle stands on the right in a 3/4 view and crosses the split line, its upper part over the plum zone and its body over the blush zone. A giant faint question mark sits behind the right side of the top zone.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Plum top zone 0-52% of the height; pale blush bottom zone 52-100%. Kicker pill 6-11% of the height, from 6% of the width. Question 13-40% of the height and 6-62% of the width (3 lines). Giant question mark 62-96% of the width and 2-50% of the height, behind everything. Answer 58-90% of the height and 6-56% of the width. Bottle 60-92% of the width and 40-93% of the height, crossing the split at 52%. Margins about 6%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Both zones flat solid color. The question mark is flat tone-on-tone with no shadow. The bottle has a soft studio key light from the upper left, a subtle white rim light separating its cap from the plum zone, a soft contact shadow on the blush zone.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, credible, honest and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas split horizontally: dark plum top zone and pale blush pink bottom zone. Top zone: small outlined fuchsia kicker pill at the top left, a very large bold white question left-aligned, and a giant faint plum question mark behind its right side. Bottom zone: a short direct answer left-aligned in the left column, its first word in bold fuchsia. The real bottle stands large on the right in 3/4 view, crossing the split line. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One oversized question mark in plum #3A1A33, very low contrast, flat, clipped at the split line.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top left, 6-11% of the height, from 6% of the width

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pill with a thin hot fuchsia outline and fuchsia text, transparent fill.

forbidden_additions: Separate seal badges, shields or certification logos (the registration number lives inside the answer)
Chat bubbles, app or social media interface elements
More than one question or answer
Arrows or connectors between question and answer
Subheadline or any text besides the kicker, question and answer
Logos or brand marks outside the bottle label

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 bold editorial two-tone question-and-answer supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The canvas is split by one clean straight horizontal line at 52% of the height: top zone flat dark plum #2B1226, bottom zone flat pale blush pink #FBE3EE, no gradient. Behind the right side of the top zone (62-96% of the width, 2-50% of the height) one giant flat question mark in plum #3A1A33, very low contrast, clipped at the split line. Top left (6-11% of the height, from 6% of the width) a small rounded pill with a thin hot fuchsia #E6177F outline and fuchsia uppercase text. Below it (13-40% of the height, 6-62% of the width) a very large three-line extra-bold white question in Montserrat ExtraBold, left-aligned, tight line spacing, with the word 'INVIMA' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0. Bottom zone, left column (58-90% of the height, 6-56% of the width): a short answer in dark plum Inter Regular, left-aligned, its first word 'Sí:' in bold hot fuchsia. On the right (60-92% of the width, 40-93% of the height) the real product in a 3/4 view, about 50% of the canvas height, crossing the split line, cap and upper label over the plum zone, body over the blush zone, soft key light from the upper left, a subtle white rim light on the cap, soft contact shadow: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern, solid hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS'. Clean, flat, everything readable on a phone. No people, no other elements.

Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
